newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen down on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen down on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to ease further on Tuesday, the settlement day, amid a lack of investor interest before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget in June, dealers said.

"(The) country's weak economic fundamentals have dampened overall sentiment," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "The index will end lower because investors and institutions are on the sideline before the announcement of the budget." The budget is due June 14.
On Monday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 9.13 points, or 0.59 percent, to end at 1,525.38. Losers outnumbered the gainers by 217 to 55.
